blocs: Help center for administrative teams, faculty, and students using KLASSCI.
Welcome to the KLASSCI documentation. Every guide is organized along two axes: by role (what you do at the school) and by module (the feature you want to master).
From zero to first student enrolled, in 8 verifiable milestones. The right entry point if you're starting a new tenant.
Vocabulary, roles, security, MESRS — the background material to understand the platform before or during setup.
Super-administrator — initial setup — full step-by-step reference for the initial configuration
Registrar — creating a new enrollment — from the form to final validation: 5 capture sections, enrollment record, validation with or without payment, student record, proof of enrollment
Bursar — day-to-day operations — record a payment, validate, view and print a financial statement, track enrollments awaiting payment
Fees & Accounting — full financial configuration reference (categories, MESRS-tiered per-class pricing, optional services, assignments)
Additional modules (LMD, schedule, grades & report cards, attendance) will be published progressively.
For any question, write to contact@klassci.com. Our team replies within 24 business hours.
